description: SkillOpt 范式蒸馏精化(Microsoft Research arXiv:2605.23904)。把 skill.md 当可训练'权重',epoch=4 训练循环,bounded edit + held-out validation gate + reject buffer。适合已有 skill_FINAL.md 的精化场景(新书首蒸仍走 distill-style.plan.json)。
_program_driven_status: v28 程序驱动 · orchestrator.run_command 可机械驱动 · 全程不调 Claude sub-agent · optimizer 走 gen-model (同 active profile)
_skillopt_paper: arXiv:2605.23904 + microsoft/SkillOpt · 论文超参 epoch=4 rollout=40 minibatch=8 L_t=4→2

steps.name: preflight-compact
steps.description: 前置:验证 skill_FINAL.md/cluster_index.json 存在 + 切 SLOW/FAST/REFERENCE 三段(skill_compactor)。
scripts: python -c "import sys, pathlib; p=pathlib.Path('{project_root}'); assert (p/'skill_FINAL.md').exists(), 'skill_FINAL.md 缺失,先跑 /distill-style'; assert (p/'cluster_index.json').exists(), 'cluster_index.json 缺失'"

steps.name: dataset-split
steps.description: 确定性切分 train/select/test = 60/20/20 (论文 SearchQA 范式)。同 seed 重跑稳定。

steps.name: train-loop
steps.description: 主训练循环 epoch=4 (论文默认)。每 epoch: rollout minibatch → optimizer 出 ≤L_t 条 patch → validation gate 严格优于才升级 → reject buffer epoch-local 反哺。

steps.name: promote-best-skill
steps.description: 把 train 产出的 best_skill.md 合并 SLOW 段提升为新 skill_FINAL.md (备份旧版到 skill_FINAL.md.bak)。
scripts: ? python -c "import shutil, pathlib; p=pathlib.Path('{project_root}'); shutil.copy(p/'skill_FINAL.md', p/'skill_FINAL.md.bak')"

python -c "import pathlib, json, glob; p=pathlib.Path('{project_root}'); runs=sorted(p.glob('_skillopt/train/*')); best=runs[-1]/'best_skill.md' if runs else None; assert best and best.exists(), 'best_skill.md 缺失'; (p/'skill_FINAL.md').write_text(best.read_text(encoding='utf-8'), encoding='utf-8'); print(f'[OK] promoted {best} → skill_FINAL.md')"

steps.name: writer-feedback-verify
steps.description: 回灌验证闸(沿用 distill_finalize_verify): 用 SkillOpt 产 skill_FINAL 灌 gen_writer 写 cluster → 与原 cluster_arc 比 → 不过 exit 2 拦。Article 6 严闭环。

_north_star_alignment: ①更贴近作者风格(trajectory-driven 优于一次性蒸馏) ②cluster 单位(每 rollout=1 cluster) ③涟漪驱动(reward 来自真实写作链路 judge,非预设) ④章节纯格式(rollout 在 cluster 层) ⑤不干涉模型判断(reward 只读现有 binary 信号,不引入新 hard_gate) ⑥清旧码(替代 dimension_evolver)
